text:
Noelle (People Ops): mini-program idea Desk Drop Mini-Kits for our quarterly Recognition Day: small kraft pouch with a sticker, mini thank-you card, and a tiny snack. low-cost and easy to hand out during desk drops or mail to remote folks. thoughts? :bag_with_gift:
Priya (HR Ops): good tactile piece. need to confirm food restrictions/allergies for people receiving snacks. maybe swap snacks for tea sachet option. Also check contractor gift policy.
Jamila (Events): can brand the pouch with a single-color stamp. options for snack: honey stick, salted almond pack, or a tea bag. vendors: PaperSack Co or SnackCrate (bulk).
Marco (Global Ops): EU printers that can do pouch + localized fulfilment recommended. For APAC, consider SG consolidation to avoid small parcel premium. Also watch for cardboard/pouch composition restrictions in some countries (e.g., moisture-sensitive).
Ben (Procurement): estimate: 500 pouches with sticker + card + tea sachet ~ $2.10/kit + shipping. Lead time 10 business days. I'll ask PaperSack for an EU print-and-ship quote and confirm if they can omit snacks for specific addresses via CSV flag.
Noelle (People Ops): audience ~410 folks incl contractors. ordering 450 kits. Priya please scope allergies & contractor checks by May 15.
Priya (HR Ops): will add an allergies field to the RSVP and draft opt-out language for those who prefer no physical items. also confirm contractor rules for UK/AU.
hr-bot: ACTION: fill Gifts & Distribution doc before ordering. link: https://drive.company/gifts
Jamila (Events): sample copy for card: "Thanks for making Redwood better — pass this along or keep it close." Include QR to #kudos for photos.
Marco (Global Ops): vendor CSV needs: name,address_line1,address_line2,city,postal,country,email,omit_snack_flag. Ben, can you confirm vendor supports conditional packing?
Ben (Procurement): vendor requested fields: name,address_line1,address_line2,city,postal,country,email. I'll ask about omit_snack_flag and multi-origin.
Noelle (People Ops): timeline: approve contents by Apr 28, finalize art May 2, order May 6, assemble May 20-24, ship May 27-31 (Recognition Day May 28). Can everyone commit?
Jamila (Events): yes, I'll post mockups in #design-review tomorrow.
Marco (Global Ops): mapping: US desk drops, EU direct-ship, APAC consolidated. I'll draft regional lead times and hubs.
Ben (Procurement): will get a quote + PO info by Apr 20. shipping estimate: US 3-5 days, EU 5-8 days, APAC consolidated ~10 days.
Noelle (People Ops): action items: (1) Jamila art + mockups (2) Ben vendor quote + PO (3) Priya allergies + contractor policy (4) Marco regional plan + CSV template. I'll make a Trello card and volunteer signup for desk drops. Any other stakeholders?
Priya (HR Ops): loop in Legal for EU customs & contractor terms.
Jamila (Events): tagging @design for approvals.
Noelle (People Ops): great. backup plan: digital badge + e-card if production delays. thanks everyone :confetti_ball:
